overview: TrendEdit AI is a template gallery app where users can browse AI-style photo templates, filter by category, search by title, apply templates to uploaded images with a fake processing animation, and manage templates via a protected admin dashboard.
features: Filter tabs: All, Trending, Popular, New
Image upload flow with fake processing animation
Protected admin dashboard with CRUD for templates
Admin login at /admin-login with hardcoded credentials
localStorage persistence for templates and auth
